body: At Lent, a lot of churches focus on self-examination and confession of sin. Many churches wish they had resources that addressed sin in a more thoughtful and far-reaching way. My friend Josh Scott wrote a litany for Ash Wednesday that could be used and adapted in many ways during Lent. I know you’ll find it meaningful and powerful – here.
